# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

Diagnosis inspects the trained NextItNet through a ModelView. Relevant components are item embeddings, causal sequence features, candidate scoring, and gated convolution blocks. `log2feats(sequence)` produces positionwise representations; diagnostic histories are truncated, left-padded, and read at the maximum nonpadding index. Structural analysis recognizes specific gated NextItNet source patterns; the model implementation itself is not supplied here.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses `view.model`, `item_emb`, `log2feats`, `predict_score`, and training histories. The loader supplies `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` as aligned B × L tensors. Probes run without gradients in evaluation mode, restoring module modes and Python/NumPy/PyTorch RNG states afterward.

Training-only prefix sampling uses seed 42, up to 12 users and two cuts per user. Catalog scoring excludes previously seen full-prefix items except the target, with deterministic ascending-ID tie breaks.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding alignment:** sampled mean pairwise cosine mapped to [0,1]; approximately 0.5 indicates zero mean cosine. This alone cannot establish collapse or quality.
- **Training margins:** mean, lower tenth percentile, negative-outranks-positive rate, and margin-below-0.5 rate across valid positions in ten loader batches. Larger margins and lower failure rates indicate stronger sampled training separation.
- **Training-prefix HR@10:** exact eligible-catalog target hits, averaged within users then across users; measures in-sample fit.
- **Intervention effects:** changed-minus-clean rank, HR@10, score, sampled margin, and top-10 overlap. Positive rank changes indicate deterioration; sensitivity itself is not inherently good or bad.

# Perturbation & Tests

Matched recent/older replacements vary dose and frequency-random/local-transition-plausible substitutions, preserving occupancy and terminal items. Only successful four-plan blocks contribute. Fixed and shared restricted catalogs separate candidate insertion effects; inserted-item gains are also recorded. Full and terminal-preserving permutations test order sensitivity.

Controls check chunked ranking, identical inputs, future-token causality, all-padding features, and applicable structurally unreachable positions.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

`run_full_diagnosis` returns `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, including protocol, coverage, failures, architecture, controls, aggregates, strata, raw observations, and cost. Aggregates include exploratory user-bootstrap intervals and separate corruption Monte Carlo errors.

Missing evidence remains null or empty. Matching does not equalize embedding displacement or exact path counts. Reviews, item categories, simulator traits, causal intent, and held-out intervention effects are unavailable. Single-category diagnosis supplies no four-category macro estimate; pinned host validation HR@10 governs selection. `diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` embeds measured results and definitions into a constrained JSON interpretation request.
